topics.name: Soybean Disease Detection
topics.description: AI models to detect soybean diseases and nutrient deficiencies from leaf images.

Week 1: Introduction to Soybean Disease Detection and its agricultural impact.
Week 2: Explore dataset directory structure and labeling format.
Week 3: Perform exploratory data analysis on 13415 images across 10 classes.
Week 5: Understand class imbalance and its impact on model bias.
Week 6: Apply resampling or data augmentation strategies.
Week 8: Split dataset into train, validation, and test sets.
Week 16: Reflection, limitations, and ethical AI discussion.
